body.primaryGoal: Book the first 10 recurring residential clients in 90 days
body.targetAudience: Busy two-income households in the Route 9 / Maple Heights neighborhoods
body.summary: Dana has cleaned houses for eight years, most recently managing a crew for a franchise, and is now going solo. BrightMove focuses on reliable weekly and biweekly residential cleaning in a tight service area. Dana refuses one-time move-out jobs and commercial contracts to protect the recurring-route model.

body.headline: The weekly cleaner Maple Heights families never have to think about
body.audience: Dual-income homeowners in Maple Heights and off Route 9 who want a dependable recurring cleaner
body.positioningSummary: BrightMove wins on route reliability, not price or 'family-owned' claims every competitor makes. Position around the same trusted cleaner every visit, a fixed weekly slot, and a two-street service radius Dana can actually keep. First place to say it: door hangers on the two target streets.
